overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, with dry fuels (ERC 64%) and low humidity (28%) as the main drivers, though winds stay light.**
- Danger stays Moderate through Oct 14, with ERC easing from 64% to 57% and BI holding near 56-60% as light rain chances build late next week.
- Sunny and mild today near 72°F with light southwest wind; a 20% shower chance arrives Friday afternoon, per NWS.
- 0 of 7 local watch-out thresholds are met today, and no Red Flag Warning is in effect for the area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions in unincorporated Montrose County were lifted as of September 16, 2026, thanks to moisture and cooler temperatures, and Ouray County rescinded all fire restrictions effective September 18, 2026; Gunnison Field Office Stage 1 restrictions were also lifted September 18, with only standard year-round rules remaining.
- No active large wildfires are reported in or near this area's counties in today's national sit report.
